description: This PHP script creates a test database by dumping an existing database's structure and data, then loading it into a new database with a test-specific name. It also generates core fixtures for testing purposes using the CoreFixtureService.

classes.name: Conf
classes.description: Configuration class responsible for providing database connection details.

classes.name: CoreFixtureService
classes.description: Service class responsible for generating and saving core test fixtures.

methods.name: saveToFixtures
methods.description: Generates and saves core fixture data for testing.
